title: The Greiflands
description: Cursed World Generation aimed at recreating the experience of finding an area of the world greifed on an anarchy server localized into a single biome
body: This mod adds one new Biome. The Greiflan. The Greiflan is a biome that adds no new mobs, no new blocks, nothing of value in a traditional sense. The Greiflan is covered in a wonderful thing called a lavacast. What is a lavacast you ask? Have you ever played skyblock? Have you ever seen flowing water and lava touch? Yes you know what I mean now. Large Cobblestone monsters topped off with lava and water that flows out from the biome covering the land in mostly lava (lmao). Most vanilla genrated structures can spawn inside this biome, but most will not survive. Hostile mobs are the only thing that spawns here and the biome is usually found near oceans and jungles.
